raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek V4 Flash with DSpark fails during NPU draft graph capture in [[this CI job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38233348303/job/114772999125)](<https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38233348303/job/114772999125>).

`MarkovSampleStep` calls `-libdevice.log1p(-uniform)`, but the Ascend backend does not map the generic Triton `libdevice` stub to its CANN implementation. The call returns `None`, causing compilation to fail with:

```
AST unary operator '__neg__' is not (currently) implemented on type NoneType
```

The sampling kernel was introduced in \#43621 and integrated into draft graph capture in \#43668.

## Modifications

- Import `triton.language.extra.cann.libdevice` on NPU in `markov_sample.py`.
- Retain the existing generic `libdevice` import on other platforms.

## Accuracy Tests

- Pre-commit checks passed.
- Host validation with mocked platform/Triton imports and real CPU PyTorch passed: library selection, greedy special values, deterministic sampling, and noise-offset advancement.
- Pending follow-up: validate NPU compilation, graph capture/replay, and rerun the failing accuracy job.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Pending follow-up: verify NPU inference performance after restoring successful compilation. No performance improvement is claimed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

files.patch:
@@ -7,9 +7,15 @@
 import torch
 import triton
 import triton.language as tl
-from triton.language.extra import libdevice
 
 from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dispatch import inputs_on_cuda
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_npu
+
+if is_npu():
+    # Ascend does not map the generic libdevice stubs to CANN implementations.
+    from triton.language.extra.cann import libdevice
+else:
+    from triton.language.extra import libdevice
 
 # Measured fastest for 1-64 rows, where the per-block Philox work sets latency.
 _BLOCK = 1024
